summary: Zoomcar Holdings filed an 8-K detailing completion of an issuer warrant exchange offer (US equivalent of a Section 3(a)(9) tender) that expired 5:00 p.m. ET August 14, 2026. Holders tendered 6,029,194 privately issued warrants via 832 letters of transmittal, accepted for 317,683,180 shares of common stock, with no cash consideration paid or received. Vinyl Equity, Inc. served as exchange agent; no placement or solicitation agent engaged. Tendering holders executed lock-ups covering 50% of shares for 12 months and the remainder for 18 months. Existing warrants retire upon issuance. Watch massive dilution, restricted-legend overhang, and the unmatched warrant-to-share conversion ratio.
